source_facts: The paper explicitly connects imaginary-time evolution to a double-bracket flow of a rank-one state and reviews its optimization geometry.
Equation (7) uses a frozen generator [Psi(0),H] for a small-step state approximation; equation (19) states the double-bracket flow; the task is fixed-Hamiltonian ground-state preparation.
our_correspondence: For one frozen R99/R100 input set H=-A/N and Psi=P; then [P,H]=[A,P]/N=K. The commutator construction and isospectral geometry are established components.
Our finite-step floor-regularized quotient and its conservative normalization need their own derivation; the cited ground-state algorithm does not establish attention Macro/CE improvement.
